question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which cheerleader would be the best Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is perfect! I feel better. And now I can think!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Reality TV is right! Switching things up makes everyone feel better...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And 'switching' gives me a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You want us to what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, from now on, you're going to be Jill. Jill, you're Maria, and Maria, you're now Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda, from here on out, you will be Hector!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to be Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hector, you are now Keith, and Keith, you are now...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't say it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't like this idea.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ahem.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahem.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I mean, `I don't like this idea... I like puppies and rainbows!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]I don't like this idea... I like puppies and rainbows![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I do too!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh whoops. I mean, `So do I, dogg!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh whoops. I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]So do I, dogg![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You want us to what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, from now on, you're wearing Jill's uniform. Jill, you take Maria's, and Maria, you take Nicole's.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't want to wear Jill's lumpy varsity jacket!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's not lumpy! And besides, there's no way I'll fit into Maria's skirt.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey now, that's not half as bad as wearing Nicole's socks!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I hate this...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too bad! It'll cheer me up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda, from here on out, you will wear Hector's uniform!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't look good in stretchy pants!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever. Hector, you take Keith's clothes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What? No way. I have a policy. Other men's shirt sweat does not touch my skin.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you questioning my authority, `Hector`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you questioning my authority, [color=#3b78e2][i]Hector[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nope. Never mind. I'll just switch jackets. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And Keith, you take...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't say it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda's uniform!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But he'll stretch it!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What are you trying to say?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Forget it, Amanda. Trade with him! And just for complaining, this will keep going until I say otherwise! Is that clear?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yes, Jessica...
A quick change in the locker room later...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You look great!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There have been a lot of rumors going around about how $ZOE betrayed the team by using the videotape to frame Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So it took me a while to realize that the person everyone should really be mad at is `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So it took me a while to realize that the person everyone should really be mad at is [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You gave her the tape! I can't believe that you would be party to such an immoral act.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: First, if there's a party, I'm `always` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: First, if there's a party, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Second, you can't accuse me of being `immortal...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Second, you can't accuse me of being [color=#3b78e2][i]immortal...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Immoral.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever! And don't get high and mighty on me! You've done plenty of shady stuff yourself! You used blackmail to break up $Scott and Angie because you wanted Angie for yourself!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's not entirely true! I blackmailed Angie because $Scott needed to be overthrown!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And so did Taylor. How is what I did so much more wrong than what you did?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The only difference... Well, there are many differences, but the biggest thing is that I wanted the Presidency so I could do good things...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You just wanted to be more popular. And you used the nicest girl in the school to do it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And I don't think I can date someone who would take down an innocent like that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You don't think you can, do you?! You'll never find anyone as good as me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I think we're done here.
Justin storms off the field, and Jessica runs back to the cheerleaders. They fall silent as she approaches.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you looking at? We're going to do this number from the top! Nerds!
Behind her, Dex and Erik continue to put electronics away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nerds! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sorry, Jessica. Erik and I are packing up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Did I say you could leave?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Didn't have to. Justin's not here, so we don't have to be either.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But you're working for me!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Actually, we're working for the President.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You always take orders from the President. He's an official official!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And he's our friend. Now that you're not with him...
Dex and Erik continue packing up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, fine!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Looks like you don't get First Lady perks anymore...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't you and $ZOE have a line to go stand in?
Taylor walks off the field. $ZOE trails slightly behind her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jessica, are we going to practice more? We can't practice if we don't know where the fireworks are going to go off...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And we can't work the AV equipment by ourselves...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So, what should we do now?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I need to think, but I'm too upset. What can we do to cheer me up?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! Reality TV shows cheer me up a lot, and they're always doing these hilarious switch-ups!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love hilarious switch-ups!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...What are those?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't you watch 'Doctor Swap' or 'Boyfriend Switch'? Or what about 'Switching Lives', where two girls swap lives?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There was this rich girl who switched with her maid, and the rich girl had to peel all of the maid's grapes for, like, a week! It's hilarious!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Fun!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: More like fun to watch! So I want everyone to...

nodes.prompt: What do you want them to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want them to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Yeah right!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Justin, you're such a kidder...
The other cheerleaders laugh nervously.
Jessica drags Justin to the side of the field.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't you take your funny self `over here?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you take your funny self [color=#3b78e2][i]over here?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Around Jessica, whispers rise up like a tide.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh-oh, domestic trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Why would he say that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I do feel a little bad for them...
Jessica's glare silences everyone before she drags Justin to the side of the field.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Justin, can I talk for you a moment `in private?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin, can I talk for you a moment [color=#3b78e2][i]in private?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `WHAT?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]WHAT?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You did not just dump `me.` I'm the one who does the dumping in this relationship!
nodes.text_bbcode: You did not just dump [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color] I'm the one who does the dumping in this relationship!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No... I'm sorry to tell you that, in this case, you're not.
Around Jessica, whispers rise up like a tide.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh-oh, domestic trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Why would he say that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I do feel a little bad for them...
Jessica's glare silences everyone before she drags Justin to the side of the field.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Justin, can I talk for you a moment `in private?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin, can I talk for you a moment [color=#3b78e2][i]in private?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica says nothing.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, aren't you going to say anything? I'm sure you're not really used to being dumped, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I... I just can't believe it!
Around Jessica, whispers rise up like a tide.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh-oh, domestic trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Why would he say that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I do feel a little bad for them...
Jessica's glare silences everyone before she drags Justin to the side of the field.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Justin, can I talk for you a moment `in private?!`

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you have enough energy to argue with me, then you'll have no problem standing in line for me in front of `Angst` later tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: If you have enough energy to argue with me, then you'll have no problem standing in line for me in front of [color=#3b78e2][i]Angst[/i][/color] later tonight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait, what? `Angst,` the super hot nightclub for teens? Standing in line is going to take the entire night! I had plans...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, what? [color=#3b78e2][i]Angst,[/i][/color] the super hot nightclub for teens? Standing in line is going to take the entire night! I had plans...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That I don't care about.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Jessica... It does sound a little unfair...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it's not. But $ZOE, if you're so concerned, you can figure out how `unfair` it is by going with her!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it's not. But $ZOE, if you're so concerned, you can figure out how [color=#3b78e2][i]unfair[/i][/color] it is by going with her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great. I can't imagine a better night than standing in line with the `traitor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Great. I can't imagine a better night than standing in line with the [color=#3b78e2][i]traitor.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now, unless anyone else has any problems, once more from the top!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Isn't practice over?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's over when I say it's over!
At that moment, Justin walks onto the field and approaches Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, Jessica, I'd like to have a word with you. In private. It's about us.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can't it wait? I have a practice to run...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You said it'd be over by now. Besides, there's an event at the arcade Dex and Erik need to go to...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's an Ogres and Elves convention!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can't you lend them to me for just a little longer? Do this for me, and we'll watch part of that robot documentary you love...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We'd watch 'Circuit Board Confessions'? That's... That's...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No wait, Dex and Erik have to go, and we need to talk about an important matter. `Now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No wait, Dex and Erik have to go, and we need to talk about an important matter. [color=#e23b3b][i]Now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! Nothing you have to say to me could possibly be this urgent!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So leave the nerds with me and get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I will do no such thing! As President, `I` control the AV Club's time, and `I` say they're done helping you tonight.
nodes.text_bbcode: I will do no such thing! As President, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] control the AV Club's time, and [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] say they're done helping you tonight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're just doing this so that I'll be forced to end practice early and talk to you, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Talk!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `I'm breaking up with you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm breaking up with you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're... You're `what?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]what?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think a girl who's been to five parties in the last four days doesn't know what's popular right now?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, when was the last time you saw a dance move that awful work at a club?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Didn't you do that exact move, like, last night?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one was asking you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But you just...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can't even get your hench-cheerleader to agree with you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know what I'm doing. It doesn't matter what you think.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not pathetic, it's `hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not pathetic, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Hot?` That was the worst hip roll I've ever seen.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hot?[/i][/color] That was the worst hip roll I've ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looking at your hips, the only thing I can see is the doughnut you had for lunch!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're a liar! I never eat doughnuts on weekdays!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think those are the only days you should refrain from eating them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wow. Harsh.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, whatever. It doesn't matter what you think.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The President should be someone you want to make out and party down with...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! I can get behind that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He has to be popular, hot, and fun! It helps if he's a little flirty too!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But only if he's flirty with me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the kind of guy I want! Go!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This will be fun!
For the next twenty minutes, the girls bring back guys for Jessica to inspect...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: How about Zach?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey Jessica, you're looking pretty built...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fun, but not as popular anymore...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What about Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why am I here? What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hot, but not fun.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What about Fryan?

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Hey, ladies... What's cooking?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Popular, but not hot.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Hey! Two of my ten girlfriends thought I looked as hot as tinfoil.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're hotter than Ryan... But that's not saying much.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: I'll take it.
Hector and Amanda bring up their choice.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Jessica, behold.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, $ZOE. Your boyfriend's safe. Now get out and wash some towels.
$ZOE happily leaves the room.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now, who's next?
Nicole, Maria, and Jill open up a yearbook and start flipping through the pages...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Andy?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too weird.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too dumb.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too greasy. Ugh, we're starting to repeat, and this is taking forever. Just give me that yearbook!
Jessica furiously flips through the pages until her finger lands on...

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's kind of cool, but way too sappy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard is definitely very sappy. You `definitely` don't want him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard is definitely very sappy. You [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] don't want him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, I totally just missed a chance to mess with $ZOE. Now she's so... Happy.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one gave you permission to smile!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe I `should` just steal him from $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] just steal him from $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What was that, Towel Girl? You weren't `defying` me, were you?
nodes.text_bbcode: What was that, Towel Girl? You weren't [color=#3b78e2][i]defying[/i][/color] me, were you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I just meant... He's... Not the best. He has flaws!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... He's... Got... Mischievous little sisters?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess that could get annoying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You `don't` want to have to deal with them. Bubble gum in your hair, toothpaste in your shoes, badgers in your backpack...
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want to have to deal with them. Bubble gum in your hair, toothpaste in your shoes, badgers in your backpack...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Badgers?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even `I` don't know where they get them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] don't know where they get them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, Howard seems like more trouble than he's worth. So I guess he's out.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But at least it was fun watching $ZOE sweat it out.
Taylor storms out.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now, where's $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp. I'm right here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, Taylor really let me down. Let's see if you can do any better.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now, I believe I said I wanted someone to stand on her head for fifteen minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Captain.
$ZOE gracefully drops down into a head stand.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is messed up, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, she can't last that long. She's going to fall over!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE, does it look like we're all on the ceiling?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. I guess it kind of does...
The minutes tick by... And everyone starts cheering for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She's actually going to do it!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: The girl's not very nice, but she `is` athletic.
nodes.text_bbcode: The girl's not very nice, but she [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] athletic.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's all about keeping your balance...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This isn't fun at all! $ZOE's not even struggling with this!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Almost there! Five... Four... Three... Two... One!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Done!
$ZOE flips to her feet and bows as all the other cheerleaders applaud.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Excuse me, did I say you could cheer?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But we're cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, no one is allowed to be `happy!` Not until I have a boyfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, no one is allowed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]happy![/i][/color] Not until I have a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now, I believe I said I wanted someone to stuff fifteen marshmallows in her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Captain.
Jessica tosses a bag of marshmallows at $ZOE, and $ZOE counts out fifteen to stuff in her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now try to say something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mmmmfffhh mmff.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's that? You want to do the team laundry for the rest of the year?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mmffffuuufff!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE. You need to speak up! If you don't want to do it, just say so!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: MMMMMFFFFHHHH!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, the rest of the year it is. Thanks, $ZOE. You're `so` sweet.
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, the rest of the year it is. Thanks, $ZOE. You're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sweet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mff.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, that certainly improved my mood enough to get back to the problem at hand... Finding a boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously I'm only going to date the most popular guy in school...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that means it's time for the rankings!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great... The most uncomfortable time of year.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just for that, Hector, you can hold the scoreboard.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... The scoreboard's nailed up on the wall...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then I guess you'll just need to pull it down and `then` hold it up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I guess you'll just need to pull it down and [color=#3b78e2][i]then[/i][/color] hold it up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, so let's take a look at Centerscore's hottest.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait a second, Jess. Wouldn't we have run into the coolest guys at the club?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the problem. I've realized a flaw in our ranking system. We usually deduct points for guys who are in relationships.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Um, yeah, because they're not available. The whole point is to see who's the best guy to get with.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But relationships end `all the time.` Guys who are in relationships are just guys waiting to be taken!
nodes.text_bbcode: But relationships end [color=#3b78e2][i]all the time.[/i][/color] Guys who are in relationships are just guys waiting to be taken!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gasp! That means...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes. Consider every guy on the market.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's kind of cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... That's terrible! You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We're here for a very important reason. As many of you know, I broke up with Justin today...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What was I saying? Oh yes. Justin. He was important to us all.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Without him, we have nothing. I don't get my personal parking spot, my extra hall passes, and my detention immunity!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And the entire cheerleading team doesn't get to use the AV Club.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That means no fireworks, no lights, and no dance party in our cheerleading routine.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So here's the plan... If the current President doesn't want to date me and shower me with perks, then we're going to switch things up.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're going to become President?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't be dumb, Maria! Being President's going to be way too much work! The plan is...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: To make my `new` boyfriend the `next` President!
nodes.text_bbcode: To make my [color=#3b78e2][i]new[/i][/color] boyfriend the [color=#3b78e2][i]next[/i][/color] President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that's where you come in... You are going to be my wingladies tonight!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right! I can do this!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The first cheerleader to find me a guy gets to...

nodes.prompt: The first cheerleader to find me a guy gets to...

options.label: Dance on a table with me!

menu.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: Hector and Amanda push their candidate forward.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Phil?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now that he's off crutches, he's back to being hot, fun, and on the football team!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And he likes to get down and party!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...I asked.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ooh... Nice choice.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'll say...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Thanks, ladies... And Hector. And, uh, Keith.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good job, Hector and Amanda!
Jessica makes shooing motions, and the cheerleaders relocate to another table, leaving Phil and Jessica alone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So Phil... Tell me about yourself. Where are you from?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I was born in Centerscore and lived here all my life. I've wanted to play ball for Centerscore ever since I was young. Lizards rule!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That'll sound good for your adoring fans and for the cameras. Are you single?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Depends on who's asking.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That'd be me.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Then definitely.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... What do you like to do?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You know me. I'm a sports guy. I like playing football, basketball, any kind of ball really.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: People do `love` sports. That's why jocks are so popular. You could get so many votes.
nodes.text_bbcode: People do [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] sports. That's why jocks are so popular. You could get so many votes.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Votes for what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Phil, how would you feel about becoming President?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Of the United States?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, of Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Isn't Justin the President?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He can't be President forever. Eventually, he has to run for re-election, and that could be your chance!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I don't know if I'm really the presidential type...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can totally become President! I'm going to ask you a question. Sound presidential.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's a good question to ask my future President boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you were President...

options.label: What would you change about the school?

nodes.text: And so, a half hour later, the cheerleaders are in Jessica's bedroom with hot chocolate, microwaved s'mores, and ice cream.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, I'm calling this slumber party to order. Taylor and $ZOE, your snack offerings are acceptable.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, it was no trouble making junk food for `everyone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it was no trouble making junk food for [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's always complain, complain, complain with you! Now, I `said` I'm calling this party to order!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's always complain, complain, complain with you! Now, I [color=#3b78e2][i]said[/i][/color] I'm calling this party to order!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I still don't understand why Keith and I have to be here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I said `EMERGENCY SLUMBER PARTY.` That means the whole team.
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#3b78e2][i]EMERGENCY SLUMBER PARTY.[/i][/color] That means the whole team.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, I'll admit it. Going to the club was a total failure and the arcade was even worse! Now I'm starting to think I'll never find the perfect guy...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, that's not true! You just need to cheer up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good idea... What would cheer me up?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know! Where's Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm right here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I want you to...

options.label: Stand on your head for fifteen minutes!
Stuff fifteen marshmallows in your mouth.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: How can we be of service, my lady?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm looking for my next boyfriend, and I'm holding interviews today. Why don't each of you tell me a little bit about yourselves?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A girl... Talking to me...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Pay no mind to my tongue-tied friend here. To be yours would be my delight! I am a great warrior, fearless in battle and peerless with a sword.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about leadership potential?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I've lead hundreds on and off the field of battle. I was even elected Sworn Shield of Sir Kalantry.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, never heard of it, but I guess nerd clubs must have their own traditions...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I... A... Girl...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, I'm just going to call that 'disqualified'.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So that just leaves Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you think? Is Andrew your next boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, should I take a chance on Andrew? Or is this just not working out?

options.label: Why not? I'll give him a shot.
No way! I'd rather die alone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know who it is! He's the perfect match!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's cute, he's smart, and he's the only one who can blend into the crowds at Angst `and` the Arcade!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's cute, he's smart, and he's the only one who can blend into the crowds at Angst [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] the Arcade!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He'd make the best boyfriend `and` the best President...
nodes.text_bbcode: He'd make the best boyfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] the best President...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Who is it?
At the arcade, Ben takes Denni's hand.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just got a sudden chill down my back is all. But I'm fine now.
Ben relaxes, sitting back with Denni on a couch away from the throng of nerds.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, thank you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm so glad you picked me. It's such a relief that the entire thing with Colt is behind us now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm happy with you. It just feels like nothing can go wrong now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing will ever tear us apart.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know that by saying that you're really jinxing us, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, it's not like anything's actually going to happen to us now that we've found each other.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now you're just doing it on purpose.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't believe in superstition, but I do believe in us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I don't want to let go of the good thing we have going.
Ben leans in and kisses Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Me neither.
Sounds like Denni and Ben `do` have a great relationship.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like Denni and Ben [b]do[/b] have a great relationship.

nodes.text: But just what is Jessica planning now? Check it out next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I got it! It's Erik! He's perfect! He's lovably goofy, but he is in with the nerds! And he was kind of popular at the convention...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, gross...
A week later...
Jessica and the cheerleaders are in their first class.
The morning announcements play. Justin and $Scott appear on screen and begin talking when the feed is interrupted with a staticky cry.
The monitor cuts to Jessica and Erik sitting next to each other in front of the soda station in a secluded part of the arcade...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jessica, will you be my... Will you be my girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you'll become the President...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, that's not supposed to be playing! Turn the tape off!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Turn the tape off!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Turn the tape off![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Around the room, everyone starts to laugh...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So you did end up dating that nerd! Nerd!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Way to go Jessica! I didn't think you'd date Paul Revere, or whatever his name is!
Jessica jumps up and switches off the video recording.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who did this?! Who is responsible for this?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It wasn't me, but it's no less than you deserve.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't you have some laundry to be doing?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We'll see what happens at cheer practice tonight... You were caught with a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the same way the Head Cheerleader was deposed last time.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, not this time! I'm the Head Cheerleader and nothing's going to change that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Jessica, for going behind our backs and dating a nerd, we're demoting you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But you were all there when I chose him! And none of you complained then.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. You violated a cheer code, the sacred rule to remain cool at all times.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But he was going to be President!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All in favor of demoting Jessica and promoting Nicole to Head Cheerleader, raise a pom-pom in the air!
All around Jessica, pom-poms rustle as hands fly into the air.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And that's settled. Our new Head Cheerleader, effective now, is Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I never thought this day would come... Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No... Not again!
Oh no! Jessica got demoted the same way Taylor did? This isn't how Jessica's run as Head Cheerleader should end!
Try again and get a better ending for Jessica!

Back to the night where $ZOE and Taylor had to stand in line...
Jessica wasn't kidding when she said the line was super long...
I wouldn't be surprised if we were here all night...
And it might be nice if we perhaps talked to pass the time?
Just stand over there.
Taylor... I wanted to say that I'm sorry... I'm so very sorry.
'Sorry'? Sorry for deposing me as Head Cheerleader and putting someone even more tyrannical than me in charge?
It's too late for that.
I thought I was helping the team out.
Ugh, you are so naive.
No wonder Jessica had such an easy time getting you to do what she wanted.
I didn't actually know she wanted to take your place.
And what did you think was going to happen when I got voted off?
Well, I thought I was going to be Head Cheerleader...
Great. That makes me feel so much better. No wonder you're so sorry that Jessica tricked you into thinking `you'd` replace me.
It wasn't like that. I just wanted cheerleading to be something that was fun again.
And it wasn't fun when I was running the squad?
You're too nice to even speak up about that. Just look what you've done...
Well, surely the other girls will see how terrible Jessica is, and things will change...
Right. Of course. The other girls. How long did you put up with me before things changed?
Er, right, good point.
You created this mess. You can get yourself out of it.
I'm still sorry about everything.
Well, don't talk to `me` about it.
Taylor and $ZOE stand in silence for the rest of the line...
Looks like it's going to be hard for $ZOE to go back to being popular again...
See what happens to her next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.text: Welcome back to another episode of Surviving High School! Last time, Jessica instated herself as the new Head Cheerleader of Centerscore!
In this episode, can you help her stay at the top of the pyramid?
Find out as Jessica's reign begins...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOW!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The lights on the football field turn on, and music starts to blare on loudspeakers set up around the field!
The cheerleaders dance in fancy patterns and circles, eventually parting for Jessica who sits atop Keith and Hector's shoulders and waves like a pageant queen.
As the music comes to an abrupt stop, the cheerleaders throw their hands up in the air and jump at once, landing in a large 'C' on the field around Jessica.
On cue, red, white, and blue fireworks go off around them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Cut, cut, cut!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She said 'cut!'
In the electronics booth, Dex and Erik frantically shut off the music and lights, as Jessica jumps down from her perch.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That was awful! Nerds! There need to be more lights on me! There should never be fewer than four on me at a time!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sorry, Jessica! I'll get on that right away, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And cheerleaders, that was the most awful thing I have ever seen! And, trust me, I've seen full-fat, regular whipped cream!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Jill, you're supposed to be cartwheeling around `me`!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jill, you're supposed to be cartwheeling around [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color]!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Sorry, I just got so dizzy...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too bad! And Maria, what was going on with your flip? That was a total flop!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm not even going to talk to you because everyone hates you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But Taylor, you're really dragging the team down. What were you even trying to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You might have heard of it before... It's called a `hip roll`, Jessica.
nodes.text_bbcode: You might have heard of it before... It's called a [color=#3b78e2][i]hip roll[/i][/color], Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All the cool people are doing it.

options.label: You think I don't know what's cool?
I know the move, but that was just pathetic!
